notes.title: MXGP PRO: A new patch released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830943/397e6cfe18fc849a0cb4567f6f7f676bcc45bd7f.png[/img]

A new patch is coming, thanks to your reports we worked to solve some problems found during the games. Here's what this update contains.🔧

Fix crash after bike changing in career transfer windows
Improved online stability
Fix to an animation glitch during rewind
Minor AI improvements to Assen track

notes.title: MXGP PRO: Patch 5
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830943/c14988e40860c1850bd57b5c593b13907d2ecd0c.png[/img]

#MXGPRO keeps on giving adrenaline, mud and thrills to all MX lovers. As you all know, though, our goal is to keep improving the game a much as possible. That's why in the last few patches we introduced major improvements to wet riding, side respawn, starting grid UI and AI. In the next few hours, we'll be releasing a new update to PS4, Xbox One and PC/Steam that will include new major improvements:

- Added online weather voting.
- Improved AI behaviour: adjusted difficulty, better trajectories, better performance in different types of terrain and wet/dry riding, more agonistic behaviours. 
- Better rider position while mid-air, during landings, and scrubs.
- Enhanced the visual animation of scrubs during replays and rewind.
- In quick match lobbies, players can now mark themselves as ‘ready’.
- Improved overall stability.

notes.title: MXGP PRO: New patch released
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830943/0148af2e13d99dbf3ccfc76cbba36698cebe581c.png[/img]
Hey riders, while you were having a blast with the new #MXGPRO, we've been working to improve the game on several aspects, considering the many and loud feedback you've been leaving us here and to our Customer Support. We're releasing in this very moment the first major patch, which will bring interesting improvements and updates. Here's the full patchnotes, let us know what you think:

- Online leaderboard result list expanded
- Gauge is now visible during starting grid
- Improved whip animation
- Minor improvements on wet physics
- Improved rain effect
- Reduced online rain weather probability
- Minor improvements to rider animations
- AI difficulty adjusted
- Fix on podium cutscene
- Fix gear shift during starting grid
- Fix Hitchhiking trophy
- Minor audio fixes
- Minor graphical fixes
- Minor UI fixes

notes.title: MXGP PRO is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830943/60255c6335b2146faa522a1ae47f60d7f0027e61.png[/img]

It has been a long wait, in recent months we have told you a lot about the game and today we are glad to confirm that MXGP PRO is finally available worldwide, while in America we will have to wait until July 10th.
For more information visit our website: https://mxgpvideogame.com/.

Have fun biker.

notes.title: Get ready for the definitive PRO motocross experience on June 29!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32830943/9c245c6607a4b4e08ccaef47dd0918c14b69d1a0.png[/img]

With MXGP PRO we enhanced everything concerning Physics and Mechanics. Expect some really nice things like more freedom during whips and scrubs, ruts that actually matter, improved suspensions and landings and much more.
To face all this, you'll have two huge MX and SX tracks, a free roaming area and 30 different challenges to learn all the motocross techniques, from the very basics up to the most advanced 👊. The new MXGP PRO Compound area will be the definitive training ground: from a newbie, you’ll become a real PRO! MXGP PRO will be out this June 29 (SUmmer 2018 for the Americas) on PS4, Xbox One and PC/Steam.

Check out http://www.mxgpvideogame.com for more info!
